title: EasyHF hardware entry
description: One tunable model in one band variant, as sold. Frequencies are whole kHz.

id.description: Stable id: brand-series-band, lower case, e.g. shure-ulxd-g51.

model.description: The unit the range applies to, e.g. ULXD4 (receiver).

channelWidthKHz.description: Occupied RF bandwidth of one carrier.

guards.description: Per-model clearances, kHz. Missing fields fall back to the engine defaults (DECISIONS.md D-006).

source.description: Official specification page or document for a shipped entry; free text (a manual, a box) for a user entry.

provenance.description: Where the figures come from. verified: checked figure by figure against the source, needs verifiedAt. manufacturer: read off manufacturer documentation, not yet checked. user: entered on the user's own device, never shipped in this repository.
